name: regex1.k
model:
class RegexTest1 {
  digit:String

  req digit = "5"

  req digit.matches("[0-9]")
  number:String

  req number = "123"

  req number.matches("[0-9]+")
  word:String

  req word = "hello"

  req word.matches("[a-z]+")
}

main:RegexTest1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((RegexTest1 (mk-RegexTest1 (digit String)(number String)(word String)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-RegexTest1 (sel-RegexTest1 RegexTest1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-RegexTest1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-RegexTest1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-RegexTest1 ((this Ref)) RegexTest1
  (sel-RegexTest1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-RegexTest1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-RegexTest1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class RegexTest1:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for RegexTest1.digit: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1!digit ((this Ref)) String
  (digit (deref-RegexTest1 this))
)

; --- getters for RegexTest1.number: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1!number ((this Ref)) String
  (number (deref-RegexTest1 this))
)

; --- getters for RegexTest1.word: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1!word ((this Ref)) String
  (word (deref-RegexTest1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-RegexTest1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class RegexTest1:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-RegexTest1 RegexTest1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RegexTest1!digit this) "5")
)

(assert (! (RegexTest1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (str.in_re (RegexTest1!digit this) (str.to_re "[0-9]"))
)

(assert (! (RegexTest1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RegexTest1!number this) "123")
)

(assert (! (RegexTest1.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (str.in_re (RegexTest1!number this) (str.to_re "[0-9]+"))
)

(assert (! (RegexTest1.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RegexTest1!word this) "hello")
)

(assert (! (RegexTest1.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun RegexTest1.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (str.in_re (RegexTest1!word this) (str.to_re "[a-z]+"))
)

(assert (! (RegexTest1.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-RegexTest1 const-1-RegexTest1))
  )
)

(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (str.in_re (digit (sel-RegexTest1 (select heap 1))) (str.to_re "[0-9]")))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-RegexTest1 a!1)))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (word (sel-RegexTest1 (select heap 1))) "hello"))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (= (number (sel-RegexTest1 (select heap 1))) "123"))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (str.in_re (number (sel-RegexTest1 (select heap 1))) (str.to_re "[0-9]+")))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              1
              (lift-RegexTest1 (mk-RegexTest1 "5" "123" "hello")))
       0
       (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (digit (sel-RegexTest1 (select heap 1))) "5"))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (str.in_re (word (sel-RegexTest1 (select heap 1))) (str.to_re "[a-z]+")))
(define-fun const-1-RegexTest1 () RegexTest1
  (mk-RegexTest1 "5" "123" "hello"))
